$comment: Single source for the /plugins download page (src/app/plugins) and scripts/build-plugin-zips.mjs, which packs every `downloads[]` entry into public/downloads/plugins/<file> before `next dev`/`next build`. `source` is relative to the repo root; `root` is the folder name the files sit under inside the zip (what the user extracts or copies into their project). `install` (optional) tells Guidon Desktop's plugin installer where the zip's `root` goes: into `<chosen folder>/<into>/`, after checking `marker` (a relative path, or `*.ext` for any top-level file with that extension) exists in the chosen folder; `folder` describes what to pick, `next` (with {server}) what to do afterwards, and `replaces` (optional) lists where older versions of the plugin sat, relative to `into` - the installer warns when one is still there but never deletes it. Downloads without it (source builds) aren't installable from the desktop app.

install.folder: Unity project folder (the one containing Assets/ and ProjectSettings/)
install.next: Delete Assets/GuidonTasks and Assets/GuidonReports if an older version left them. In Unity: Window → Guidon → Tasks, set Base URL to {server} and log in; Reports in its toolbar sets up in-game bug reports.

install.folder: Unreal project folder (the one containing the .uproject file)
install.next: Delete Plugins/GuidonTasks and Plugins/GuidonReports if an older version left them. Reopen the project and let the editor build the modules, then open Window → Guidon Tasks, check the Base URL ({server}) and log in; Reports in its toolbar sets up in-game bug reports.

install.folder: Godot project folder (the one containing project.godot)
install.next: In Godot: Project → Project Settings → Plugins, disable and delete Guidon Tasks/Guidon Reports if an older version left them, enable Guidon, then log in to {server} from the Guidon panel; Reports in its toolbar sets up in-game bug reports.
In Blender: Edit → Preferences → Add-ons, enable Guidon Tasks and log in to {server}.
